meta.name: nara editor
meta.note: Independent JSON format for implementation mapping; not a claim of compatibility with an external token schema.
meta.scope: Expanded reusable components and eight practical editor workspaces; the v0.3 docking, document, context, runtime and task contracts are retained.
meta.image_policy: The v0.4 raster mockups illustrate layout and workflow states. They do not prove implementation, numerical performance, signal accuracy or complete state coverage.

meta.dimension_scope: Reference workspace and default panel sizes, not fixed geometry for every docked view.
meta.constraint_policy: Each view type declares its content constraints. The existing minimum examples are not universal group minima.
meta.narrow_window_policy: Offer explicit collapse, maximize, restore, or compact-layout choices; do not rewrite the saved DockTree at fixed width breakpoints.

meta.scope: Shared component mappings and specialized editor workspaces; all entries are design targets, not implemented engine behavior.
meta.value_policy: Literal values are provided. Existing foundation tokens are reused without changes. Tool-specific mappings remain proposed until implementation review.
meta.image_policy: Generated images guide appearance and context; exact values and behavior come from the Markdown specification and these tokens.

new_palette_value.reason: The existing foundation palette has no violet; this color identifies UV/Vector2 ports and their data wires only.

meta.sample_policy: Documentation examples describe illustrative snapshots only. They are not resource defaults, measured results, supported product limits or an implementation claim.

boundary.policy: Use subtle divisions for structure and clear boundaries where interaction requires them; do not outline every row or panel with the control border.

state.runtime_activity_policy: A runtime marker can coexist with another selected object; activity is never communicated by selection fill alone.

color_rgb.scope_note: Reused blue hue denotes Color/RGB only inside this graph; it does not denote a Z axis here.

texture2d.scope_note: Reused green hue denotes a texture resource port only inside this graph.

port.swatch_policy: A color parameter swatch shows its value; its socket and outgoing wire use the Color/RGB type color. An amber GlowColor swatch therefore retains a blue socket.
port.conversion_policy: No implicit type conversion unless the operation explicitly declares it.

declared_broadcast_example.scope: Explicitly supported Multiply inputs only; not a global automatic conversion.

scene_inspector.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
scene_inspector.visible_scope: Inspector shows selected count, target world and source. Pinning keeps explicit ownership visible.
scene_inspector.multi_select: Merged fields require compatible types and edit semantics; mixed axes remain independent.
scene_inspector.gizmo: Per-view tool context, visible coordinate/pivot/snap modes, one transaction per gesture.

assets_importer.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
assets_importer.draft_settings: Show an edited state and clarify whether the preview uses current settings or the last successful import.
assets_importer.save_and_reimport: Validate and save the settings, then schedule a versioned import; a completed settings save does not guarantee import success.
assets_importer.revert_settings: Discard the settings draft explicitly; do not imply deleting source data or undoing unrelated generated artifacts.
assets_importer.dependency_view: Distinguish used-by references from dependencies and preserve stable navigation targets.
assets_importer.late_result: Verify source revision, settings revision, importer version and platform before publication.

animation_workspace.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
animation_workspace.time_basis: Track rows, ruler, curve editor and key inspector use one explicit clip time basis.
animation_workspace.curve_view: An independently docked Curve view may share the same animation document. It follows the outer ViewInstance contract rather than a separate nested docking framework.
animation_workspace.preview_binding: Views share a preview context only through an explicit binding; duplicate views do not implicitly share all playback state just because they share a document.
animation_workspace.preview: Transport controls change preview time; normal preview does not record keys or start the full game.
animation_workspace.recording: Persistent record state and target/write policy are visible before recording can create data.
animation_workspace.key_edit: Preserve relative time offsets for multi-key movement; distinguish interpolation from tangent mode.

profiler_console.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
profiler_console.capture_state: Live, capturing, stopped and captured views are explicitly distinguishable.
profiler_console.timing_domains: CPU, GPU and thread intervals retain their own source/domain; overlapping work is not blindly added as frame cost.
profiler_console.console_history: Filtering and clearing a view do not rewrite source records or silently rebind older diagnostics to the current run.

project_input_settings.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
project_input_settings.scope: Project settings, user preferences and input-asset content are visibly distinct.
project_input_settings.capture: A transient interaction with an explicit input owner, visible cancel action and no accidental command or game-input propagation.
project_input_settings.conflict: Report the actions, map, devices and overlapping activation context; do not treat every duplicate key as a universal error.
project_input_settings.missing_device: Keep authored bindings editable and explain disconnected or unavailable devices.
project_input_settings.edit_during_play: Saving an input asset does not silently replace the configuration of an active RuntimeSession. Any supported apply-to-run operation is explicit and identifies its target and revision.
project_input_settings.apply_to_running: End binding capture and release old pressed-key/action states before the runtime bridge applies the selected version. Failure preserves explicit target/version feedback; unsupported hot application takes effect on the next run.

particle_editor.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
particle_editor.module_order: Only supported reorder operations are enabled; validate dependencies and preserve stable module identities.
particle_editor.seed_scope: A preview seed is explicitly labeled. If the effect also authors a seed, expose it as separate content.
particle_editor.lifetime_controls: Display normalized lifetime separately from seconds; gradient position, color and alpha are distinct values.
particle_editor.failed_update: Retain last valid preview when available and mark its version/staleness with diagnostics.

audio_mixer.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
audio_mixer.meter_unit: Explicit level reference such as dBFS when supported; do not label measured signal level as authored gain.
audio_mixer.audition_mute_and_solo: In Editor Audition mode, M/S are transient audition filters. They do not rewrite saved gains or routing. Persistent bus enablement and effect bypass remain explicit resource fields.
audio_mixer.routing: Explicit destination with validation; reject unsupported cycles and preserve the current valid route on failure.
audio_mixer.audition: Explicit Editor Audition owner, event, bus, transport and stop behavior; it is separate from full-game Play.
audio_mixer.cross_document_action: Use the documented cross-document coordinator or restrict the compound write; do not claim atomic history without support.

build_profiles.illustration_policy: The referenced PNG is a conceptual UI snapshot. Exact types, values and lifecycle behavior follow the Markdown and JSON contracts.
build_profiles.job_input: Immutable snapshot of the saved or explicitly supplied validated profile and content revisions.
build_profiles.existing_runtime: An existing RunSession retains its launch snapshot. Build failure does not stop it, and build success does not silently replace it with a new artifact.
build_profiles.retry: Create a new attempt with a newly identified input snapshot; explicitly label any reuse of an older resource snapshot. Do not rewrite the previous attempt record.
build_profiles.failure: Show stage, target, path or resource location, reason and repair action; preserve the result after the task view closes.
build_profiles.run_artifact: Enabled only for a compatible, verified successful artifact; a failed attempt cannot expose a successful result from a different revision as its own.
build_profiles.cancel: Stop future work when possible and report actual completed side effects; do not equate cancellation with deleting outputs.
build_profiles.undo_scope: Profile content edits are undoable; build execution and filesystem side effects have their own task contract.

meta.scope: Shared outer docking model for document, viewport, utility and auxiliary views.
meta.format_note: Declarative design mapping, not an implemented Rust API or an external schema compatibility claim.

change_note.reason: Window resizing must not silently turn user-docked panels into drawers or overlays, or rewrite the saved DockTree.
change_note.existing_dimensions: Preserved as default layout examples; content constraints and user docking determine actual geometry.

meta.visual_reference_policy: The v0.3 outer docking contract supersedes global document strips and pseudo-docking headers in retained v0.2 detail images.

model.document_view_binding: A ViewInstance may bind a DocumentSession; the ViewInstance does not own or duplicate its content.

tab_strip.app_bar_role: Project, menus, workspace and run commands; it is not a second resource-tab host.

split_duplicate_view.availability: Requires MultiInstance policy and the declared duplicate/split capability; singleton types do not expose duplicate-view commands.

close_group_or_floating_window.behavior: Coordinate user-requested closure of contained views; it is not implicit docking back.

view_factory_contract.tool_open_policy: Declared separately by the view factory; additional Inspector or observer views may be created explicitly.

tool_composition.auxiliary_detach: Use an explicit command to expose the auxiliary content as an ordinary outer ViewInstance with a declared context binding.

meta.scope: Shared document editing state, content history, save state and lifetime.
meta.format_note: Declarative design mapping, not an implemented Rust API or an external schema compatibility claim.

lifecycle.other_primary_views_remain: Close only the requested ViewInstance and retain the shared DocumentSession.
lifecycle.auxiliary_view_close: Remove presentation only; a bound observer is not automatically a primary document editor.
lifecycle.auxiliary_bindings_after_document_close: Unbind or show an explained closed/unavailable target with a reopen action; do not block document closure through observer references.
lifecycle.clean_session_eviction: Explicit DocumentStore policy after checking pending operations and valid bindings, not implicit view reference counting.

save.target: Resolved effective editing context, otherwise the window active document when valid.

pending_edit_coordination.scope: All editing buffers bound to the target DocumentSession, including its other views and implicit Inspector editors.
pending_edit_coordination.valid_input_path: Validate baseline revision, commit through the normal content transaction, then include the resulting revision in the write snapshot.

save_all.candidate_set: Dirty DocumentSessions UNION DocumentSessions owning pending edits or buffers.

undo.cross_document_changes: Require a transaction coordinator and whole-operation validation/undo, or declare the action unsupported.
undo.layout_recovery: Separate workspace restore/reset commands, not content Ctrl+Z.

meta.scope: Per-window focus, active view, effective command context and explicit Inspector bindings.
meta.format_note: Declarative design mapping, not an implemented Rust API or an external schema compatibility claim.

active_document.policy: Track the window document editing context; focusing a utility tab alone does not manufacture or replace a document target.

routing.missing_target_behavior: Unavailable with a reason; do not use an unrelated last nonempty selection.
routing.agent_and_batch_target_resolution: Explicit request context, never incidental keyboard focus or pointer position.

selection.sharing_policy: Declare the selection context or link group for each view family; do not infer sharing from equal labels or adjacent tabs.

inspector.pinned_binding: Explicit document or world scope plus stable target identity.
inspector.pinned_target_missing: Show an unavailable binding with a recognizable target label and context; do not silently bind another same-named object.
inspector.tool_local_inspector_selection_binding: Tool-local node/key inspection follows its declared owner context; generic pinned Inspectors retain their explicit targets.

meta.scope: RuntimeSession and output-view lifetime, run controls and game input ownership.
meta.format_note: Declarative design mapping, not an implemented Rust API or an external schema compatibility claim.

absolute_pointer_mapping.rendered_image_origin: Unclipped transformed output-image origin, including pan/scroll offset.
absolute_pointer_mapping.display_scale: Actual rendered logical units per output pixel, derived from the output-to-display transform while preserving the selected physical display policy.
absolute_pointer_mapping.invalid_or_zero_image_rect: Do not map or dispatch an absolute output click.

run_controls.parallel_session_ui: May be staged later; identifiers and command targets remain explicit.

meta.scope: Personal layout persistence, schema evolution and accessible multi-window recovery.
meta.format_note: Declarative design mapping, not an implemented Rust API or an external schema compatibility claim.

apply_or_reset_layout.open_document_reachability: Remap open documents into reachable groups or the Open/Unsaved Documents registry.

window_restore_geometry.missing_monitor_fallback: Restore to an available monitor, preferring the main window monitor, then constrain bounds to its usable work area.

restore.corrupt_or_unsupported_layout: Preserve recoverable data and offer last-valid/default layout without altering content documents.
restore.missing_plugin_view: Keep a closable placeholder with saved factory identity, binding and valid restorable state.
restore.missing_document_binding: Show the missing target explicitly; do not substitute another same-named resource.
restore.view_state_version_migration: View factories version their local state; invalid local state can reset that view without replacing the entire DockTree.

meta.scope: Versioned asynchronous inputs, output targets, cancellation and durable task diagnostics.
meta.format_note: Declarative design mapping, not an implemented Rust API or an external schema compatibility claim.

result_acceptance.stale_result_policy: Discard, retain as clearly historical/stale, or cache without mutating current content; never silently publish it as the latest valid result.

meta.foundation_policy: Reuse the approved color, size, spacing, typography and state tokens. No additional global palette or density is introduced.

geometry.column_policy: Reserve stable areas for units, validation, origin and reset affordances; state changes must not make the value column jump.

property_row.invalid_buffer: Retain typed text and the last valid model value. Save coordination must detect uncommitted or invalid edits.
property_row.local_edit_vs_external_update: Preserve the local buffer and explain the conflict; do not silently overwrite either version.

numeric_vector_range.escape: Cancel the local edit or preview and restore each target gesture-start value only while the original binding and baseline remain valid.
numeric_vector_range.escape_after_external_change: Do not write a stale start snapshot over a newer value; remove only this interaction preview and expose the conflict.
numeric_vector_range.linked_axes: Explicit option with property-defined semantics; never infer linking from adjacency.
numeric_vector_range.excluded_targets: Show count and exclusion reason; do not silently create missing components.
numeric_vector_range.range_handles: Show both bounds, units and interval semantics. Validate them together; invalid Min greater than Max retains the input and error rather than silently swapping values.

enum_flags_toggle.flags_edit: Change the selected flag while preserving other bits unless an explicit replace-all command is used.
enum_flags_toggle.flags_popover: Stage checkbox changes in the popover; Apply commits them as one transaction and Cancel discards that local buffer. Unknown bits are preserved.
enum_flags_toggle.unknown_value: Preserve the original serialized value and expose an unknown-value state; do not silently select the first option.
enum_flags_toggle.long_options: Searchable, keyboard navigable, and return focus to the opener.

asset_entity_reference.drop_commit: Validate type, target and scope before writing; invalid drop preserves the original value.
asset_entity_reference.repair: Explicit replace or reconnect operation through the same command and undo path as ordinary assignment.

color_curve_gradient.curve_axes: Show domain, units and normalization mode when used.
color_curve_gradient.gradient_stop_identity: Stable stop identity independent of sorted position.
color_curve_gradient.lifetime_domain: Normalized lifetime must be explicitly labeled; it is not automatically seconds.
color_curve_gradient.full_editor_undo: Each drag, insertion, deletion or interpolation change is its own logical transaction.
color_curve_gradient.compact_staged_popover: May stage the entire curve or gradient change; Apply commits one transaction and Cancel discards the staged preview.
color_curve_gradient.escape: Restore valid local open/gesture-start values or discard staged preview; after an external change, do not overwrite a newer version with a stale snapshot.

tree_list_table.hidden_selection: Preserve selection by identity and show total/hidden counts; a batch action states whether it affects the full selection or visible items only.
tree_list_table.semantic_reordering: An authored ordered list uses a validated content transaction; a view-only sort does not.
tree_list_table.tree_drop: Distinguish insert-as-sibling from reparent-as-child; validate cycles, ownership and target capability.
tree_list_table.table_columns: Use stable headers, aligned values, meaningful units, resizable widths and recoverable overflow.
tree_list_table.visibility_column: Declare whether it changes editor-only visibility, object enablement or an authored render property; these meanings are separate.

search_filter_picker.asynchronous_results: Accept only matching query generation and owner context; preserve current selection by identity.
search_filter_picker.no_results_action: Retain query and offer clear or adjust filters.
search_filter_picker.picker_commit: Explicitly accept a compatible item; cancel preserves the original assignment.

menu_palette_popover.command_context: Capture an explicit target context and revalidate it before execution.
menu_palette_popover.keyboard: Navigate, confirm, cancel and return focus to the opener.
menu_palette_popover.placement: Window-owned popup layer with clipping and screen-edge avoidance.
menu_palette_popover.disabled_action: Explain why the command is unavailable.

binding_capture.escape: Cancel listening. Binding Escape itself requires an explicit selection path.
binding_capture.input_owner: The capture interaction consumes relevant input so it does not trigger editor commands or full-game actions.

feedback_dialog.unknown_progress: Indeterminate state with truthful current phase; do not fabricate percentages.
feedback_dialog.durable_failure: Persist diagnostic, owner, input revision, target and retry context beyond a toast.
feedback_dialog.cancel_race: Cancel requested is not terminal. If work committed before cancellation took effect, report the actual completed result; confirmed cancellation or stale generation prevents publication.
feedback_dialog.dialog: Explain target, impact and choices; Cancel preserves the user work and restores focus.
feedback_dialog.save_dialog_scope: Include hidden dirty documents and pending edits. If some targets save while others fail, report the per-document result rather than claiming Save All succeeded.

ui_reference_set.pdf_docx_policy: This release does not regenerate PDF or DOCX; previous v0.3 documents retain their version.
